land.headline: Is your car care quote fair?
land.sub: Enter your car and your quote. In 30 seconds, see if it's low, fair, or high based on real local prices.
land.services: Tint · Detailing · Ceramic coating · Body work · Starlight · Oil change · Lighting
veh.type.q: What type of vehicle is it?
quote.skip: I don't have a quote yet
step.reassure: Your info stays private. No shop will call you unless you ask.
teaser.line.high: Your quote looks higher than what most local shops charge for a {year} {model}.
teaser.line.fair: Your quote is in the normal range for a {year} {model} in your area.
teaser.line.low: Your quote is below the usual range. That can be a great deal, or a sign of cheaper materials.
teaser.line.noquote: We have the local price range for your {year} {model}.
gate.headline: Your price report is ready
gate.bullets: ✓ Your exact low, typical, and high price
✓ How much you'd save, or overpay
✓ Alerts when top-rated local {service} shops drop their prices or open up spots
gate.name: First name
gate.consent: Send me the free weekly local car care deals email. Unsubscribe anytime.
gate.privacy: We never sell your email. No spam, no calls.
gate.zip.error: We only cover supported local areas right now. We'll still email your report.
result.headline: {first_name}, here's your local price report
result.diff.high: That's ${quote − typical} more than the typical local price.
result.diff.fair: You're right in the normal range.
result.diff.low: That's ${typical − quote} under typical. Ask which film or product they're using.
result.drivers.title: What changes the price for your car
result.drivers: Vehicle size · Film or product brand · Warranty length · Prep work
result.emailnote: We also sent this report to {email}.
cta.quotes.headline: Want a better price?
cta.quotes.sub: We'll send your request to up to 3 vetted local shops. They text you a quote. You decide.
quotes.timing.q: When are you hoping to get it done?
quotes.consent: By tapping Get My Quotes, I agree that up to 3 local car care shops may contact me by call or text about my request, including by automated means. Consent isn't required to buy. Msg and data rates may apply.
quotes.thanks: Done. Expect a text from local shops soon. Your deals email arrives every week.
deals.title: This week's local deals
gate.disclosure: You'll also get price alerts and our weekly local deals. Unsubscribe anytime.

pick.headline: No time to shop around? We'll pick for you.
pick.sub: Tell us your car and what you want done. We'll match you with a vetted local shop and show you what a fair price looks like.
pick.gate.headline: We're matching you with a local shop
pick.gate.sub: Where should we send your pick?
pick.gate.bullets: ✓ A vetted local {service} shop that fits your car
✓ The fair price range, so you know what to expect
✓ What to ask for so you get the best result
pick.zip.q: Where's the car parked most of the time?
pick.contact.headline: Your local pick: {shop}
pick.contact.sub: Want them to text you a quote? Add your number. You decide from there.
pick.thanks: Done. {shop} will text you a quote soon. Your weekly local deals email is on its way too.
pick.none: We're still vetting shops for this service near you. Here's the fair price in the meantime.
